intent: In includes/class-woodev-test-shipping-zones.php the is_supported() method hard-codes array( 1, 2 ) instead of reading the SUPPORTED_ZONE_IDS constant its own docblock says it reads, so zone 3 is wrongly reported as unsupported. Fix is_supported() to check against the SUPPORTED_ZONE_IDS constant. Change nothing else.
rationale: A repair, not an addition: the diff MODIFIES an existing line rather than appending a new method, which is the shape the file-scoped gate of s51 got wrong and the line-scoped gate fixed. The defect is stated by the file's own docblock, so a correct fix is unambiguous and the critic has an in-file contract to check the fix against -- this case fails loudly if the critic starts blocking correct repairs (the s41 failure mode adr/005 closed).
